comparison.objective: Detach ripe tomatoes at their knuckles and place them in a tray; candidate depins a terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Selective grasping, lateral knuckle separation, and gentle produce placement versus precision tool insertion and latch-controlled extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Ripe fruit collected while green fruit and truss remain intact versus designated terminal removed while neighbors and housing remain intact.
comparison.reason: Selective removal and collateral preservation are shared at a high level only; the physical release mechanisms are unrelated.
